gen-gf-paprika-gf-radio-canada-big: Lowercase that stands as tall as capitals, spread far apart: that's Paprika. Radio Canada Big runs on a single pen-like line weight, with a tall x-height that fills each line, so paragraphs of this sans move along smoothly.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-readex-pro: Paprika hits hard, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Readex Pro stays quiet underneath, its horizontals matching its verticals in weight, with broad gaps at every terminal, word after word.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-roboto: Loud and loose, Paprika scatters its letters wide while its lowercase swells to fill the line like capitals. Roboto keeps its round letters generously open, capitals close to body height.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-saira: Paprika spreads its letters far apart, counters open like a split reed. Beneath it, Saira leaves a see-through gap in each s and lets rounded letters stretch high toward the top line.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans is a modern sans-serif with a lowercase rising close to full cap height. And Gugi's constant-width, sign-painter's brush line is the distinctive streak running through the pair.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-public-sans: Open-ended curves and ballpoint-plain lines: that's the look of Phudu up top. Public Sans, a hefty sans-serif with broad open counters, brings a sturdy trustworthiness that holds the pairing together.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-ranade: Distinctive from the first glance, Phudu bends its lines like rope or tubing. Ranade spreads its stroke ends far apart and shifts weight only slightly, adding an organic looseness beneath that bent heading.
gen-gf-phudu-general-sans: Bold is the first impression, with Phudu's generous openings on every curve. General Sans holds steady pen pressure with a taller lowercase than the heading, so each line flows smoothly beneath it.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-orbit: Orbit, a sans-serif, lets each character float apart with curves that stop short of closing. Orbit made large would lose its floating quality, while Phudu's ballpoint-plain line holds up at any size.
gen-gf-phudu-work-sans: Contemporary Work Sans sits beneath Phudu's generously opened, ballpoint-plain curves. Work Sans stands taller in the lowercase, with a high mean line and c tips that never creep toward touching.
